facts.text: BeamlineStatus is an ophyd Device in the HXN startup profile
The file imports Device, Component as Cpt and EpicsSignalRO from ophyd
shutter_status is a Component of EpicsSignalRO on PV SR-EPS{PLC:1}Sts:MstrSh-Sts
beam_current is a Component of EpicsSignalRO on PV SR:C03-BI{DCCT:1}I:Real-I
beamline_enabled is a Component of EpicsSignalRO on PV SR:C03-EPS{PLC:1}Sts:ID_BE_Enbl-Sts
cryo_filling is a Component of EpicsSignalRO on PV XF:03IDA-OP{CC:1}V3_STS
The profile instantiates BeamlineStatus with an empty prefix and the name beamline_status, so the Component PV names are absolute

The profile uses beamline_status.beam_current in SuspendFloor, beamline_status.shutter_status in SuspendBoolLow, beamline_status.beamline_enabled in SuspendBoolLow and beamline_status.cryo_filling in SuspendBoolHigh

measures.description: Storage-ring master-shutter status, a fresh read of PV SR-EPS{PLC:1}Sts:MstrSh-Sts; the source states no unit or encoding
measures.name: shutter_status

measures.description: Storage-ring beam current, a fresh read of PV SR:C03-BI{DCCT:1}I:Real-I; the source states no unit
measures.name: beam_current

measures.description: Beamline-enabled flag, a fresh read of PV SR:C03-EPS{PLC:1}Sts:ID_BE_Enbl-Sts; the source states no encoding
measures.name: beamline_enabled

measures.description: Cryogenic-cooler refill flag, a fresh read of PV XF:03IDA-OP{CC:1}V3_STS; the source states no encoding
measures.name: cryo_filling

measures.description: Read the current value of one or more sensor channels and return the values with a sampling timestamp and a monotone sequence number. Volatile channels are also available by subscription.

inputs.description: Channel names to return: shutter_status, beam_current, beamline_enabled, cryo_filling. Omit the input to return every channel; an unknown name fails the call
inputs.name: fields

measures.name: read_channels

safe_state.description: unchanged: the package only reads four EPICS PVs and never writes to an IOC; an e-stop engages the endpoint's software latch and stops nothing physical
